title: Compare two decision-boundary panels
description: You inspect the feature-count guard and protected plotting calls.

steps.description: You enter the plotting branch only when X has two feature columns. The left panel scatters training points colored by y_tr.
You try to draw the gradient-descent boundary with w_gd. The panel labels identify standardized feature coordinates.

steps.question: What happens if the Newton boundary helper raises an exception?
steps.answer: The except block passes without printing an error. The scatter panel and its later title remain part of the plotting branch.

steps.description: You display the Newton panel beside the gradient-descent panel when the guard passes. Other feature counts print a message that skips the two-dimensional plot.
